title: VCMI map object type format
description: Description of map object type, used only as sub-schema of object

compatibilityIdentifiers.description: Additional identifiers that may refer to this object, to provide compatibility after object has been renamed

anyOf.description: Battleground that will be used for combats in this object. Overrides terrain this object was placed on
Battlegrounds that will be used for combats in this object. Overrides terrain this object was placed on. Will choosen random

battleTerrain.description: Terrain the combat at this object takes place on. Overrides the map tile terrain and the battlefield is selected from this terrain (e.g. subterranean for an abandoned mine)

visit.description: Sound that played on object visit

removal.description: Sound that played on object removal
